intro.displayText: Every app remembers things, and it keeps them in a database. Your mission: do a roll call at the Grove Critter Club by asking its database your very first questions!
intro.speechText: Every app remembers things, and it keeps them in a database. Your mission is to do a roll call at the Grove Critter Club, by asking its database your very first questions!

recap.displayText: Roll call done, and every critter answered! Your new word is query: a question you ask a database, like SELECT name FROM critters.
recap.speechText: Roll call done, and every critter answered! Your new word is query, which means a question you ask a database.

intro.displayText: Nearly every app keeps its data in a database, and SQL is how developers ask it questions. You'll learn how tables, rows, columns and primary keys fit together, and write SELECT queries with calculated columns. Then you'll fix a price list and build a stock report for Pixel Pier, a game shop.
intro.speechText: Nearly every app keeps its data in a database, and sequel is how developers ask it questions. You'll learn how tables, rows, columns and primary keys fit together, and write select queries with calculated columns. Then you'll fix a price list and build a stock report for Pixel Pier, a game shop.

recap.displayText: You can read a table's design and pull exactly the columns you need, calculated ones included. The gotcha to remember: a missing comma in a SELECT list isn't an error. SQL reads the second name as an alias, so check your result's column names.
